history_warning: All these evaluation dates were consulted in R17.26; these are chronological model-held-out retrospective tests, NOT untouched independent research validation. No prospective paper/live proof.
partitions: Same rolling two-month tree fit + following one-month calibration + next-month evaluation as R17.26. Purge181min at each boundary and require each label exit before boundary. Sample fit/cal every15min. All symbols and directions grouped by time. Book and price-only model training/evaluation use identical valid-book rows for controlled feature ablation.
features: Reuse causal R17.26 minute returns/ATR/distance/flow/volatility and genuine depth snapshots. Add causal180min return/volatility and 60min directional efficiency. Include horizon-specific stop_fraction. No data after decision+0; fills1minute after decision.
targets: Gross realized signed return in units of horizon-specific R; class positive-return, conditional mean gainR, conditional mean lossR, expected log1p duration minutes, direct mean realized returnR. Stop clamp(2*ATR14/lastclose*sqrt(horizon/8),.003,.02), target2R, time exit at horizon open; stop-first ambiguity. Labels and execution use same economic barriers but label reference open excludes execution frictions, applied separately to EV and fills.

model.calibration: Sigmoid probability on later calibration month; additive mean calibration bias for direct return and conditional magnitudes; duration expm1 plus calibration mean bias; positivity bounds on gain/loss/duration only.

ablation: mean_payoff_price: classifier+constant calibration class payoffs, EV rank. magnitude_price: conditional gain/loss regression replaces means, EV rank. duration_price: conditional EV / predicted duration. duration_book: adds genuine book features. direct_book: direct mean return regression / duration. conservative_book: direct return minus half calibration residual RMS / duration. duration_book_no_adaptive: same predictions/sizing but no loss/drawdown pauses. rule_momentum: deterministic side aligned ret20, EMA20/EMA60 and ret180, horizon180, same scaledATR barriers. reference: R17.26 volume impulse control replayed unchanged.
execution: Reuse R17.26 adverse minute taker fills, public current tick/lot/min-notional scenario, previousminute0.1% participation cap and HyperGrok exact stressed-stop sizing. Exposure caps same for ML/rule candidates. Stops/time exits; no same-minute reallocation from intrabar profits. Fees, spread, slippage and funding included; original control preserves original maxweight15% and no new adaptive pauses.
ev: Estimated gross conditional p*gain - (1-p)*loss, or direct meanR, times stop; subtract0.24%normal/0.48%stress roundtrip plus last-known adverse funding for potential settlement. Require strictly positive net EV; horizon ranking by EV or EV/estimatedduration as variant specifies. No low-cost hypothetical used as observed performance.
selection: July-Oct select among seven ML variants only, same normal winner for stress. Eligible if PF>1.2, >=100trades, positive3/4windows, DD<=20%, stress net positive and normal totalreturn above control. Max totalreturn with lexicographic tie; otherwise CASH. Write selection before November replay. All variants diagnostic-reported but cannot change selection.
promotion: No main merge. Require selected policy >=5%monthly equivalent under normal AND double costs, PF>=1.2, Sharpe>=1, DD<=20%, >=100trades, outperform control and positive November. Even a pass requires new independent forward evaluation due reused historical dates.
verification: Unit tests causal labels/features, temporal purge181min, gain/loss arithmetic, duration ranking, costs, position sizing, samebar ordering, funding, terminal reconciliation. Every trade/daily/monthly/mark curve reconciled and DD cross-checked with vendored MIT Vibe-Trading. Models/predictions hashed. Paired daily ablations and block-bootstrap descriptive intervals, no claim of selection-adjusted p-value.
